evidence.alignment: All four technologies target high-growth EV/autonomous driving markets with boom windows clustered in 2026-2028, demonstrating strong market timing awareness; however, the small portfolio of only 4 technologies limits coverage breadth.
evidence.sequencing: Dependency chains are correctly respected—T08 (전장 제어보드) starts only after T03 (자율주행 AI) completes in 2028-Q1—but all technologies finish significantly after their market boom windows, with a mean timing error of 1.94 years indicating consistent late-to-market risk.
evidence.investment: Strategic tier is appropriately assigned to the two highest-scored technologies (T03, T01) with market_opp=5.0 and urgency=5.0, while High tier is correctly applied to T08 and T05; no low-potential technology is over-invested.
evidence.coherence: The four technologies form a coherent EV/autonomous mobility stack covering AI architecture, battery manufacturing, vehicle electronics, and charging infrastructure, presenting a clear end-to-end strategic narrative from energy to intelligence.
evidence.balance: The portfolio is skewed toward Strategic/High tiers with no Exploratory or Medium investments, and all technologies target the 2026-2030 window without any near-term quick wins or longer-horizon research bets, creating concentration risk.

strengths: Zero dependency violations with correct prerequisite sequencing (T03 → T08)
Strong market-technology alignment with all selections targeting confirmed high-growth EV and autonomous driving segments
weaknesses: Systematic late timing across all technologies (mean error 1.94yr), risking missing peak market boom windows and ceding first-mover advantage
Portfolio is too small and tier-concentrated (only Strategic/High) with no diversification into exploratory or medium-risk bets
missing_technologies: 고체 배터리 (Solid-State Battery) for next-gen energy density
V2X 통신 (Vehicle-to-Everything Communication) to complement charging infrastructure matching
자율주행 센서 융합 (Sensor Fusion / LiDAR) as a foundational layer for autonomous AI
investment_issues: No budget has been allocated (spent=0) despite a 22.7B budget, suggesting the investment strategy is defined in tiers but not yet translated into actual capital deployment
Two Strategic-tier investments simultaneously (T03, T01) may strain execution capacity and management attention without a phased capital release plan
timing_issues: T03 다중 태스크 자율주행 AI completes 2028-Q1 but boom is 2026-Q4, arriving 1.25 years late—development should start earlier or be accelerated
T08 차량용 전장 제어보드 targets 2030-Q1 vs boom 2027-Q2 (2.75yr error)—the prerequisite dependency on T03 pushes it too far past the market window
T05 차량용 충전 인프라 매칭 ends 2030-Q1 vs boom 2027-Q4 (2.25yr error)—has no dependencies and could realistically be started and completed earlier
